description: This source file defines a custom logger class LangsmithLogger for logging events and batch processing to Langsmith, a logging/monitoring platform. It includes methods for preparing log data, handling batching, and sending logs via asynchronous HTTP requests. The file also manages credentials, sampling, and context-specific configurations. It is specific to the Langsmith integration within a larger codebase.

classes.name: LangsmithLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class for logging events and batching them to Langsmith platform, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous logging, credential management, and batching logic.
